properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
JJO ne leero n'okutuusa
Emirembe gyonna,Yesu
Aba bumu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Kye kiddukiro-eky'amaanyi
Mwe tuwummulira fenna
Nga tukooye.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yatunoonya mu lukoola
Mwe twabulubuutiranag,
Nga tubula.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ebibi bye twakolanga.
Yesu abinaaza byonna,
Mu musaayi gwe.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Yesu Mulokozi waffe,
Mukama w'abantu bonna,
Tukusuuta.
